notes: v12 BRAIN DIAGNOSIS + MIC HOLD: (1) Bara Dimagh ab KHAMOSH fail nahi hota — Settings mein 'Bara Dimagh ki halat' block: key lagi hai ya nahi, switch ON/OFF, aur aakhri rabte ka result. 'Bara Dimagh test karein' button asal rabta test karke jawab bol kar batata hai. Command fail ho to Dost wajah bol kar batata hai (maslan 'key ghalat lagti hai'), console aur Activity log mein bhi likha jata hai. (2) Key 'save hai lekin parh nahi sakta' wali kharabi pakri gayi — configured ka matlab ab hai: key asal mein chal sakti hai. (3) Naya switch 'Mic ki awaaz band rakho' (Settings): ON karne par jab tak Dost sun raha ho, mic ki beep bilkul band — lekin itni dair doosri apps ki media awaaz bhi band rahegi; Dost ki apni awaaz phir bhi chalegi.
